moat_against: Semiconductor cyclicality — revenue fell in FY2024 and FY2025 despite the moat
Concentrated giant foundry customers with pricing power
Large capable rivals in filtration/purification and materials (Pall and others)
CMC-acquisition leverage still on the balance sheet; share count dilutes about 2%/yr
Heavy Asia fab exposure — Taiwan/China demand and export controls
moat_for: Qualification lock-in — switching a qualified yield-critical consumable means costly, risky re-qualification
CMP slurry/pads effectively a two-supplier market at advanced nodes (with Fujimi)
Leading filtration/purification positions in advanced fabs, with sole-source niches
Deep patent portfolio and decades of materials-purity know-how
Content per wafer rises as nodes shrink and purity requirements tighten
moat_justification: Genuine qualification lock-in in yield-critical consumables and an effective duopoly in CMP slurry at advanced nodes, but the moat did not protect earnings through the 2023-25 downcycle, giant foundry customers hold real pricing power, strong rivals contest the core niches, and the CMC acquisition debt load limits flexibility.
name: Entegris, Inc.
one_liner: Real-moat semi materials name (6/10) in a genuine recovery, but at $150.47 it prices in a decade of supercycle — weighted IRR 5.98%, IV@15% $38.22; it clears 15% only at $38.22, less than a third of the price.
